svg.title: Four-Input Convergence into Theorem C in Stage 05 (LongForms.lean)
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical diagram of the Stage 05 four-input convergence proving Theorem C (New.Data.integral_forms_long) inside LongForms.lean. The top layer presents two Stage 05 solid-border inputs and two external dashed-border typed black boxes: (1) Auxiliary Spanning Forms (SpanningForms.lean + LongForms.lean, emerald) uses exists_span_isAuxiliaryForm_eq_top and Stage 04 Theorem B (at most n' <= 4d / b^2 missing basis vectors), each costing 2 x_1^2 b^2 + b (archimedean norm plus squared turn-ratio scalar height 2 m^2 t x_1 <= b), canceling b^2 via mul_completion_cost_le to total completion cost <= d * b; (2) Chain Determinant Factorization (NormOfChain.lean + Stage 04 det_rallisOnGood_eq, cobalt) provides exists_chainDeterminant_one_div_eq factoring Z(1) / Z(xi_iota) = (Nm(Q)^(e/2) * prod_{1 <= i < j <= m} quotientRatio_{i,j})^(-d) * prod_{j=1}^m Z_j(1) / Z_j(xi_iota^j), with inverse quotient-ratio scalar height m^2 t x_1 <= b; (3) Stage 06 Typed Black Box (06_one_lift/lift_volume_height, amber dashed) supplies heightLe_liftDeterminant_ratio bounding the height of each single-lift ratio Z_j(1) / Z_j(xi_iota^j) for 1 <= j <= m by d * (f a log^4 b / m - k * directionAmount); (4) Stage 07 Typed Black Box (07_congruences/fit_twists_exist, rust dashed) supplies exists_isRegularFamily producing a regular twist family theta satisfying FitTwists.lean's IsRegularFamily theta (HasSmallRatios and IsDenominatorBound within denominatorBudget = f a log^3 b / (m k)), feeding theta to Input 3 and HasSmallRatios to Inputs 1 and 2. In the middle Convergence Hub (LongForms.lean + Stage 01 TwistedLattice), Sub-Card A extends the linearly independent family y_1,...,y_n by n' = d - n auxiliary forms at total completion cost <= d * b, while Sub-Card B (heightLe_chainDeterminant_one_div) sums the m single-lift heights via m * k * directionAmount = D.mainAmount and adds the scalar height m^2 t x_1 <= b to obtain HeightLe (d * (b + f a log^4 b - D.mainAmount)) on Z(1) / Z(xi_iota). Both enter Stage 01 TwistedLattice.covolume_add_index_nonneg (integral_forms_long_with_completion_cost) to yield d * (D.mainAmount - f a log^4 b - b) <= c + 2 delta + (d - n)(2 x_1^2 b^2 + b) <= c + 2 delta + d * b. Absorbing 2 d b <= 2 d f a log^4 b yields the bottom Theorem C banner (New.Data.integral_forms_long): d * (D.mainAmount - 3 f a log^4 b) <= c + 2 delta, which feeds directly into Stage 01 New.star_inequality (01_reduction/main_inequality).

g.text: Missing basis: n' ≤ 4d / b2 · cost/vec: 2 x12 b2 + b
Archimedean norm exp(2 x12 b2) + squared turn-ratio height 2 m2 t x1 ≤ b
b2 cancels ⇒ total completion cost ≤ d · b
mul_completion_cost_le : n'(2 x12 b2 + b) ≤ 4d(2 x12 + b−1) ≤ d·b
Inverse quotient-ratio scalar height: m2 t x1 ≤ b (via HasSmallRatios)
For regular family θ (from ④) and each lift 1 ≤ j ≤ m:
Height(Zj(1)/Zj(ξιj)) ≤ d·(f a log4 b / m − k·directionAmount)
Converts k · log b · denominatorBudget = f a log4 b / m
Negative −k·directionAmount drives Theorem C (unpacked in Stage 06)
∃ regular twist family θ satisfying IsRegularFamily θ:
HasSmallRatios: gcd(ℓ, Nm Q) = 1, (ratio)−1 height ≤ x1
IsDenominatorBound: ∑ γ(ℓ) ≤ denominatorBudget = f a log3 b / (m k)
Feeds θ to ③ single lifts & HasSmallRatios to ①② (Stage 07)
Extend y1,…,yn (covol ≤ c, index ≤ δ) by n' = d − n
auxiliary forms (n' ≤ 4d/b2), each ≤ 2 x12 b2 + b
Completion cost: (d − n)(2 x12 b2 + b) ≤ d · b
B. SUM m SINGLE LIFTS (② + ③ + ④)
Sum j = 1…m via m · k · directionAmount = D.mainAmount + scalar height m2 t x1 ≤ b:
HeightLe ( d · ( b + f a log4 b − D.mainAmount ) ) on Z(1) / Z(ξι)
Invoke Stage 01 product-formula floor on completed target basis
d · ( D.mainAmount − f a log4 b − b ) ≤ c + 2δ + (d − n)(2 x12 b2 + b) ≤ c + 2δ + d · b
fold 2 d b ≤ 2 d f a log4 b
Absorb completion & scalar heights: 2 d b ≤ 2 d f a log4 b
■ THEOREM C — LOWER BOUND FOR INTEGRAL TARGET FORMS
d · ( D.mainAmount − 3 f a log4 b ) ≤ c + 2δ
for any linearly independent y1,…,yn spanning ≥ (1 − 4/b2) d dimensions (covolume ≤ c, index ≤ δ)
Cancels d·D.mainAmount vs. Thms A & B → GRH
LEGEND: ●◆ Solid = Stage 05 internal · ▲■ Dashed = Stage 06 / 07 typed black boxes · FEEDS: Stage 01 01_reduction/main_inequality
